source_clock.transform: hour=start_hour+floor((elapsed_minute+1e-9)/60), one-based CSV hour; original timestamp retained; array row=hour-1 only in original pipeline
source_clock.grid: quarter-hour decision union hourly and registered exogenous edges; no native operating segments

building_grouping.transform: original build_zone_groups: priority proxy scaled only within original building total; P3 residual; never add zone totals again

building_electric_direct_auxiliary.transform: source_reference/construct_request: P3 original electric reference minus already included fan+CHW, then current building auxiliaries added once; separate HeatSys pump is an addition
building_electric_direct_auxiliary.device_auxiliary_boundary: existing EC/ABS all-in coefficients already include registered condenser/tower auxiliaries; no separate duplicate plant fans

adopted_thermal.transform: P3_heat += target-legacy_delivered; total heat=space_original+ordinary_target; fan driver subtracts target and restores legacy proxy, heat circulation follows full current heat
adopted_thermal.local_laundry_booster: source references only; booster electricity already in direct baseline; no extra charge or assured central preheat

plant.transform: GT electricity/steam/fuel full-load ratios retain common planner surrogate; all steam sources/sinks use steam_kWh_per_lb*exchanger_eff equivalent basis; raw useful loads are not multiplied by COP

hardware_and_events.transform: pure physical scenario copied consistently from both registered aliases; no policy or completed-result field used; GRID unavailable only at[60,120) for grid branch

initialization.note: 0 is the existing certificate core log count only, not proof of no underlying initialization MILP; builder never initializes or solves

source_quality.role: evaluation_only provenance, controller_input=false; no rescaling/deleting source demand
